name: Perf hotspot
instruction:
Treat the selected code as a performance hotspot.

Explain:
1. What work dominates (CPU, memory, I/O, GPU)
2. Algorithmic complexity and constant factors
3. Cache / locality / allocation pressure
4. Parallelism opportunities and hazards
5. Concrete, ordered optimization steps with expected impact

Avoid vague advice; tie each suggestion to the code. Match the explanation language requested by XPlain.
